name: Competition Ready
description: Successfully prepare for and compete in an official VEX IQ tournament
criteria: Complete tournament preparation checklist. Compete in official VEX IQ tournament. Pass robot inspection. Complete all qualification matches. Present to judges with engineering notebook.

name: Championship Performance
description: Achieve top-tier performance metrics in competition
criteria: Win at least 50% of qualification matches OR rank in top 25% of teams OR earn tournament award (Design, Judges, etc.) OR qualify for championship event.

name: Engineering Excellence
description: Demonstrate exemplary engineering process and documentation throughout the season
criteria: Maintain detailed engineering notebook with 20+ entries. Document complete design process with data and testing. Include iteration cycles with measured improvements. Create competition-ready presentation materials.
